attributes.body_ja:
「ば〜ほど」は、接続助詞（せつぞくじょし）の「ば」と名詞（めいし）の「ほど」の組（く）み合（あ）わせです。「(A) になれば、もっと (B) になる」のような意味（いみ）で、(A) の程度（ていど）が変（か）わると、それと一緒（いっしょ）に (B) の程度（ていど）も変（か）わるときに使（つか）われます。

「ば〜ほど」を使（つか）うときは、まず動詞（どうし）やイ形容詞（けいようし）に「ば」を付（つ）けて、仮定（かてい）の形（かたち）を作（つく）ります。名詞（めいし）やナ形容詞（けいようし）の場合（ばあい）は「なら」を使（つか）います。次（つぎ）に、同（おな）じ語（ご）の連体形（れんたいけい）と「ほど」を続（つづ）けます。そして、(A) の影響（えいきょう）で変化（へんか）することを (B) に入（い）れます。

また、名詞（めいし）やナ形容詞（けいようし）の場合（ばあい）は、「な」や「なら」を「である」にすることもできます。「である」は「だ」のかたい言（い）い方（かた）です。

注意点（ちゅういてん）

この文法（ぶんぽう）をスル動詞（どうし）と一緒（いっしょ）に使（つか）う場合（ばあい）、「する」に付（つ）く名詞（めいし）は、「ば」の部分（ぶぶん）で一度（いちど）だけ使（つか）えば大丈夫（だいじょうぶ）です。「ほど」のところで、もう一度（いちど）繰（く）り返（かえ）す必要（ひつよう）はありません。

豆知識（まめちしき）

仮定（かてい）の「ば」の部分（ぶぶん）を省略（しょうりゃく）して、「ほど」だけを使（つか）う場合（ばあい）もありますが、意味（いみ）はほとんど変（か）わりません。
attributes.body:
ば～ほど is a combination of the conjunction particle ば, and the noun ほど. It is used in a similar way to 'the more ~ the more' in English. Literally, it just highlights that 'if it is (A), then the limit of (A) will be controlled only by its extent'.

To use ば～ほど, ば will be paired with the hypothetical form of any verb/い-Adjective (or noun/な-Adjective with なら on the end), before the same word will be repeated in its attributive form. After this, a (B) part of the sentence will highlight what the expected result of (A) is.

As である (the formal version of だ) may replace な with な-Adjectives (or なら with nouns), sometimes である will be used instead of な/なら, in regard to both nouns and な-Adjectives.

Caution

When this expression is used with する verbs, the noun that する is linked to in the ば part of the sentence does not need to be repeated in the ほど part.

Fun Fact

Sometimes, the ば 'hypothetical' part of the sentence will be omitted altogether, leaving ほど to perform a similar function by itself.

attributes.source: A Dictionary of Intermediate Japanese Grammar
[AIAIJ] An Integrated Approach to Intermediate Japanese

attributes.description: How does ほど work in the 〜すれば〜するほど construction?
Using 「ほど」 to express the extent of something

attributes.body: ば is a conditional form that emphasizes the condition needed for a result, e.g. 勉強すればうまくなるよ ('If you study, you'll get better.'). ば〜ほど builds on this to mean 'the more (A), the more (B)' e.g. 勉強すればするほど、うまくなる ('The more you study, the better you'll get.').

Both can be used to describe change, but with different patterns. ば〜ほど expresses a proportional relationship between two things, like 'the more (A), the more (B)', e.g. 練習すればするほど上手になる ('The more you practice, the better you get.') 一方だ shows a continuous, one-way change in a single direction, e.g. 物価は上がる一方だ ('Prices just keep rising.')

second_relatable.title: 一方だ
second_relatable.meaning: More and more, Continue to, Keep on, -er and -er

attributes.body: どんどん is an adverb that implies rapid or dramatic change, often in leaps and bounds, e.g. どんどん大きくなる 'grow rapidly'. 〜ば〜ほど is a structure that shows proportional change, like 'the more (A), the more (B)' in English. For example, 大きくなればなるほどいい ('The bigger it gets, the better.').

first_relatable.title: どんどん
first_relatable.meaning: Progressively, Rapidly increasing, More and more

attributes.body: ほど (sometimes written in kanji as 程) has the basic meaning of 'extent'. ば〜ほど shows a proportional relationship, similar to 'the more (A), the more (B)', e.g. 練習すればするほど上手になる ('The more you practice, the better you get.') When used alone, ほど means 'so much that (A)' or 'to the extent of (A)', e.g. 驚くほど静かだった ('It was quiet to a surprising degree.' / 'It was so quiet that I was surprised.')

second_relatable.title: ほど
second_relatable.meaning: The more, About, To the extent that, So much… that

attributes.body: They are similar in that both describe change, but ば〜ほど specifically expresses a proportional relationship between two things, like the English 'the more (A), the more (B)', e.g. 見れば見るほど好きになる ('The more I look, the more I like it.'). In contrast, ますます simply emphasizes continued intensification, e.g. 彼の人気はますます高まっている ('His popularity is steadily rising.')

second_relatable.title: ますます
second_relatable.meaning: Increasingly, More and more, Decreasingly, Less and less, Keep -ing
